ask: mkae a vote for each hous rule plz
sentence: Lets each person vote in or out on a fixed list of house rules, one rule at a time, and shows running counts and who voted each way.
use_when: A household or roommate group needs to agree on a set of house rules
Everyone should give an in or out answer on each rule separately
You want to see how many people have voted on every rule
A short list of rules needs a quick group check
dont_use_when: The group needs to pick one option from several choices
People need to suggest or add their own rules or write free text
You need a ranked or scored vote, or a schedule or chore split

options: Bathroom chore wheel, switches every Sunday
No pad thai leftovers in the fridge more than 4 days
